messages:
alex: Hey @runtime-team @security — pinging for quick reviews on https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/8477. Changes: kernel eviction header tweak (runtime) + safer header parsing to avoid leaking user tokens in logs (security). Hoping to merge in tonight's 18:00 UTC merge window if all clear. TL;DR: perf neutral, fixes a race on hot path, adds a small sanitizer in logging.

priya: Looking now. main question: do you have a microbench run for tail latency?

alex: Yes, ran a 10k-req run on a dev pool: p50 ~ 12ms (no change), p99 + ~0.6ms on worst case with new evict path. Full results: https://internal.redwood/reports/pr-8477-bench.pdf (summary in PR).

priya: cool. can you paste the exact kernel flag you toggled? want to smoke-test locally.

alex: "--kv-evict-threshold=0.85" and added conditional path: ```diff -- a/runtime/evict.c
+ if (kv_usage > threshold) evict_old_keys();
```

carlos: CI hit one flaky infra test (k8s node drain) on the last run, looks unrelated but marking. @alex can you rebase on main and push?

alex: rebased and force-pushed. CI retriggered.

ci-bot: build #8477.2 — linux-unit-tests: passed, integration-e2e: flaky (retrying), security-scan: passed

jen: skimming the logging change — nice catch on token masking. couple of q's: 1) can we centralize the sanitizer in loglib rather than inline? 2) add a unit test for the mask so future devs don't regress.

alex: good call. moved sanitizer to loglib and added a test (see last commit). snippet of test: ```assert(mask("Authorization: Bearer abc123") == "Authorization: Bearer [REDACTED]")```

tia: quick note from release side — if this makes the p99 worse we might skip tonight. priya, if perf looks good to you, i'll greenlight from release ops.

priya: gave it a quick smoke on a dev replica, p99 delta within noise. i'm +1 for runtime approval pending jen's security ok.

jen: verified the sanitizer unit test and static scan — no secrets left in artifacts. security +1.

priya: runtime +1 after one more travis-ish run (but CI already looks good).

ci-bot: integration-e2e: passed on retry. all checks green.

alex: thanks all — merging into main and scheduling deploy to staging. i'll follow up if anything trips in canary. :tada: 

tia: thanks alex, i'll reserve the 18:00 UTC merge window for main -> canary traffic if you want us to cut the release.

alex: yes please, that'd be great. I'll post a quick rollout note once canary is up.

carlos: noted the infra CI flake as transient. nice work team.

alex: Appreciate the quick eyes everyone.
